_doc: Brands with one tenant per branch (founder, 2026-09-29; docs/standards/dali.md §7). Each group lists its branch tenants by slug; a slug may be in one group only, and a slug with no tenant yet is skipped until it is provisioned. scripts/facts/branchGate.ts checks each branch against the others: its rows may not carry another branch's phone, map link, address or staff name (onboarding refuses, publish refuses), and the price rows and booking link must agree across the group (publish refuses; onboarding holds the tenant). `allow_names`: staff names that may appear in every branch's rows, for a person who really works at both branches, or a name that is also an ordinary word the rows use. Only the founder adds one. `allow_phones`: the brand's shared lines (one number each), which every branch may hold in its contact rows and say in its rows; every other phone stays one branch's own. Only the founder adds one. `say_phones`: another branch's own numbers a branch may SAY, only in its `other_branch_in` rows (never in its contact rows, never anywhere else; refused without `other_branch_in`). Only the founder adds one. `allow_addresses`: another branch's address (exactly as its address row reads) that every branch may give, and `allow_names` may hold a branch name for the same reason (founder, 2026-10-01, D-170: Яармаг's Дали names Парк Од and gives its address). Only the founder adds one. Since 2026-10-04 «Салбарууд» is symmetric (founder): each Tara branch names the other (its address, its own phone numbers, its Page). Tara has no shared line (founder, 2026-10-04, final): Яармаг 76001888 and 91005498, Парк Од 99076874 only; so `allow_phones` is empty and the other branch's numbers are `say_phones`, so both branch names are in `allow_names` and both branches' addresses in `allow_addresses`; Яармаг's VIP Center address (its November move) is listed ahead of the move so the move-day SQL needs no config change. `not_offered`: per branch slug, the price variants that branch does not offer at all (a level it has no hairdresser for). That branch carries no row for them and the drift check accepts the missing row; every price it does carry must still equal its siblings'. A row for a variant it says it does not offer is drift. Only the founder adds one (founder, 2026-10-04: Парк Од has no 1-р зэрэг hairdresser and never quotes that level; founder, 2026-10-08: her only men's hairdresser, Tuchku, is Мастер, so she never quotes the SPECIAL men's cut). `other_branch_in`: the only rows (by the gate's source label) where the other branch's name and its allowed address may appear; anywhere else they are a leak (review, 2026-10-04: a copied «this is the X branch's page» in an FAQ is still caught). `not_offered` entries are a variant name (every service) or {"service", "variant"} (that service only). `staff_aliases`: per branch, the other names its staff are called by (exactly the Cyrillic names in its KB «Үсчдийн нэр»; Tara's rosters are Latin only, so no short_name carries them); the gate searches the other branch's rows for them as for a short name. Change them with that document.
